latest.title: Predicting outcomes in PEA cardiac arrest
latest.finding: Witnessed arrest (RR 1.65) and prehospital ROSC (RR 23.31) predicted favourable neurological outcome at 1 month; rhythm conversion predicted good outcome in cardiac PEA but poor outcome in non-cardiac PEA (RR 0.73); apparent harm from adrenaline and advanced airway management attenuated after time-dependent adjustment

latest.title: Drone AI for mass-casualty triage
latest.finding: The system measured four vital signs from drone imagery via video PPG, thermal imaging and neural networks, generated triage decision support, and transmitted casualty location, vitals and triage category to response teams and dispatch

latest.title: Australian alcohol harms keep rising
latest.finding: Survey and wastewater consumption measures declined from 2010 while rates of most alcohol-related harms, including ambulance attendances, increased substantially

latest.title: Interprofessional simulation shapes student identity
latest.finding: Two themes emerged — Negotiating Professional Authority and Preparing for Collaborative Practice — with students reporting the simulation reshaped how they enacted the paramedic role, particularly around advocacy, handover and assertive communication
